title: Apodex 1.1: Scaling Agentic Intelligence for Complex Work

title: ReWorld: An Interactive World Model with Long-Horizon Memory

title: Beyond the Stability-Exploration Dilemma: Environmental Regularization for LLM Policy Optimization
task: Stabilizing policy optimization via environment-side (query) regularization
key_results: ERPO replaces Policy-KL with Query-KL; achieves stronger accuracy on 6 math benchmarks with more stable behavior under high-temperature decoding and long-horizon training
comments: Moving regularization from action to query distribution is novel; QKL does not constrain response gradients, preserving exploration—elegant solution to stability-exploration tradeoff.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Query distribution drift, not response drift, is the primary instability source in LLM policy optimization
hypotheses.result: ERPO via Query-KL achieves stability without constraining action-space exploration

hypotheses.hypothesis: Dataset-static per-query weights improve convergence by biasing toward reference-typical queries
hypotheses.result: Reference-derived weighting stabilizes optimization across 6 math benchmarks

title: Towards a Densing Law for User Representation Learning at Billion-Scale Capacity
task: Characterizing data and tokenization scaling for billion-scale user representation learning
key_results: Raw data exhibits scaling bottleneck at billion-scale; approximately linear relationship between log(tokenization capacity) and log(data size); ALGN adaptive tokenization improves capacity allocation
comments: User Behavioral Densing Law quantifies tokenization-data scaling relationship; systematic characterization on Alipay dataset is valuable but generalization to other domains unclear.

key_results: Pass@1: 65.36%, Pass@20: 25.25% across 507 policy-conditioned workflows; many failed trials show valid actions but incorrect state—response-level metrics are poor reliability proxies

hypotheses.hypothesis: Entity corruption is the dominant failure mode (87-96%), not downstream retrieval
hypotheses.result: Surface-form mitigations leave most performance gap intact

title: Tracking flat bands via phonon-mediated interband scattering
task: Identify flat-band proximity to Fermi level via temperature-dependent resistivity fingerprint
key_results: Sublinear resistivity at high T when EF within FB states; superlinear when away from FB; universal signature independent of electron-phonon coupling strength
comments: Elegant use of standard transport measurement as FB screening tool; mechanism traced to scattering phase-space change in interband transitions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: FB proximity produces characteristic sublinear/superlinear resistivity curvature at high T
hypotheses.result: Validated across kagome, pyrochlore, and Cu3Au-type FB materials; mechanism robust to microscopic details

title: Spatial sampling of hemispherical arrays for three-dimensional photoacoustic computed tomography
task: Optimize hemispherical transducer array spatial sampling for 3D photoacoustic computed tomography
key_results: Fibonacci distribution shows superior structural robustness and globally balanced reconstruction quality across diverse acquisition scenarios
comments: Systematic benchmarking of sampling strategies provides practical guidance, though comparison limited to three representative distributions.

hypotheses.hypothesis: Isotropic sampling properties (Fibonacci distribution) improve global reconstruction stability
hypotheses.result: Fibonacci distribution consistently demonstrated better performance under static, noise, reduced-element, and rotational scenarios
